title: About Us
text:
🌱 About Prairie Community & Innovation Hub


Connecting People. Sharing Knowledge. Building Communities.


Prairie Community & Innovation Hub is an emerging, independent community-focused initiative intended to connect Saskatchewan residents with useful information, learning opportunities, community resources, and research insights.
Our planned areas include education, employment resources, newcomer support, public health information, research and data, and community participation.
We are developing the platform progressively. We do not claim to be a registered charity, government agency, licensed immigration consultancy, or established provider of services listed on this website.
Contact us →
